# Open Journals at Ball State University

> > A collection of peer-reviewed open-access academic journals spanning Robin Hood studies, mathematics, African studies, and special education, hosted by Ball State University Libraries.

Open Journals at Ball State University provides a platform for rigorous scholarly publication across multiple disciplines. The journals feature undergraduate research, special thematic issues, and interdisciplinary scholarship with a commitment to open access and peer review.

## Key Topics

- peer-reviewed journals
- open-access publishing
- Ball State University
- Robin Hood studies
- undergraduate research
- special education
- mathematics research
- African studies
- literary analysis
- post-medieval texts
- folklore and literature
- graph theory
- historical fiction
- realism and verisimilitude
- heroic narrative

## Core Journals

- [The Bulletin of the International Association for Robin Hood Studies](https://openjournals.bsu.edu/biarhs): Main journal page for Robin Hood Studies bulletin hosted at Ball State University, featuring scholarly analysis of Robin Hood folklore, adaptations, and literary traditions
- [Mathematics Exchange](https://openjournals.bsu.edu/mathexchange): Peer-reviewed undergraduate mathematics research journal by Ball State University, showcasing original research in graph theory, applied mathematics, and mathematical modeling
- [Burkhardt Review](https://openjournals.bsu.edu/burkhardtreview): Peer-reviewed academic journal on African studies, gender studies, and colonial history, exploring intersections of culture, identity, and historical narratives
- [Journal of Special Education Preparation](https://openjournals.bsu.edu/JOSEP): Open-access journal for special education teacher preparation and evidence-based instructional strategies, supporting educators and researchers in special education

## Current Issues & Special Collections

- [Vol. 7 No. 1 (2025): The Bulletin of the International Association of Robin Hood Studies Special Issue - Explorations In Realism And Verisimilitude In Post-Medieval Robin Hood Texts](https://openjournals.bsu.edu/biarhs/issue/current): Current special issue examining realism and authenticity in post-medieval Robin Hood literary adaptations and historical fiction
- [Vol. 19 No. 1 (2025): Mathematics Exchange, Fall 2025](https://openjournals.bsu.edu/mathexchange/issue/current): Current issue of Mathematics Exchange featuring undergraduate research in graph theory, disease dynamics modeling, and applied mathematics
- [Gen(d)erations: Special Issue of Burkhardt Review](https://openjournals.bsu.edu/burkhardtreview/issue/current): Special issue exploring intersections of gender, sexuality, and African history with contemporary scholarly perspectives
- [Vol. 5 No. 3 (2025): Journal of Special Education Preparation](https://openjournals.bsu.edu/JOSEP/issue/current): Current issue of the Journal of Special Education Preparation featuring evidence-based practices and teacher preparation research
